before_png_only_analytical.note: Counterfactual PNG-only LCP requires controlled network throttling to be meaningful. Reporting transfer-time deltas from raw asset sizes instead — these dominate LCP on the hero critical path.
before_png_only_analytical.interpretation: On slow 4G (representative of mobile field conditions for executive prospects), the WebP wiring drops the hero transfer from ~7.3s to ~0.26s. LCP improvement is roughly proportional to this delta because the hero image is the LCP element on every viewport.

lighthouse_proxy_verdict: PASS — live LCP 516-596ms is well under Google's 2500ms 'Good' threshold at both desktop and mobile viewports. Hero asset is 48KB WebP (96.5% smaller than the 1.37MB PNG).
